nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the Clown sale is active; toggled by flipSaleState and read by mintClown.
Maximum Clown NFT supply, set in the constructor.
Constant price per Clown NFT (0.075 ETH) used in mintClown payment checks.
Constant cap of 20 tokens purchasable in a single mintClown call.
Timestamp after which the starting index can be locked; compared against block.timestamp in mintClown.
Provenance starting index derived from blockhash modulo MAX_CLOWN.
Block number recorded for later blockhash-based starting index derivation.
Array of four payout addresses used by withdrawAll.
Array of payout percentages (80,15,3,2) used by withdrawAll.
Public provenance hash set by setProvenanceHash.
Owner-only function that pushes contract balance to the four withdraw addresses by percentage via low-level send.
Owner-only function that safely mints 20 reserve tokens to msg.sender.
Owner-only function updating REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Owner-only function updating CLOWN_PROVENANCE.
Owner-only function updating the base token URI.
Owner-only function toggling saleIsActive.
Payable public mint function; loops _safeMint and may set startingIndexBlock based on block.timestamp.
Public function deriving startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock (weak randomness).
Owner-only fallback to set startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
ERC721 internal _safeMint that mints then calls _checkOnERC721Received, enabling receiver callbacks.
ERC721 internal callback helper performing an external functionCall to the receiver contract.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used across access control and minting.
block.timestamp, miner-influenced value compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mintClown.
Low-level payable(...).send(amount) external value transfer inside withdrawAll, executed before state finalization.
blockhash(startingIndexBlock) % MAX_CLOWN used as pseudo-randomness in setStartingIndex.
External functionCall to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received via Address.functionCall, giving control to an untrusted receiver.
Parameter of mintClown controlling how many tokens to mint.
Cached address(this).balance local variable in withdrawAll.
Per-recipient payout amount computed in withdrawAll.
Cached totalSupply() local variable in reserveClown.
Loop counter in reserveClown.
Parameter of setRevealTimestamp assigning REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Parameter of setProvenanceHash assigning CLOWN_PROVENANCE.
Parameter of setBaseURI forwarded to _setBaseURI.
Token id computed from totalSupply() inside the mintClown loop.

edges.reason: withdrawAll is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() to msg.sender.
withdrawAll reads the withdrawAddresses array to determine payees.
withdrawAll reads withdrawPercents to split the balance.
Cached contractBalance flows into the amount computation for the send.
Computed amount is passed to the low-level send.
withdrawAll transfers ETH via send before finishing, exposing external call control.
reserveClown mints reserve tokens to msg.sender.
Loop counter i drives reserveClown iteration.
reserveClown calls _safeMint which triggers a receiver callback.
revealTimeStamp parameter is assigned into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setRevealTimestamp writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable.
setRevealTimestamp is restricted by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
provenanceHash parameter is assigned into CLOWN_PROVENANCE.
setProvenanceHash writes the CLOWN_PROVENANCE state variable.
setProvenanceHash is restricted by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
setBaseURI is restricted by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
flipSaleState is restricted by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
numberOfTokens drives arithmetic checks (supply add, price mul) in mintClown.
mintClown requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mintClown enforces numberOfTokens <= maxClownPurchase.
mintClown compares totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) against MAX_CLOWN.
mintClown multiplies ClownPrice by numberOfTokens for the payment check.
mintClown mints tokens to msg.sender as the buyer.
mintClown branches on block.timestamp relative to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP (timestamp dependency).
mintClown reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when to lock the starting index.
mintClown calls _safeMint inside a loop, invoking receiver callbacks mid-mint.
mintClown writes startingIndexBlock when conditions are met.
mintClown derives mintIndex from totalSupply() inside the loop.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to compute the hash seed.
setStartingIndex takes blockhash modulo MAX_CLOWN for the starting index.
setStartingIndex performs blockhash-based pseudo-random computation.
The blockhash randomness result is written into startingIndex.
setStartingIndex assigns the computed startingIndex state variable.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is restricted by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock to block.number.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received, handing control to the receiver.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external functionCall to the receiver contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Mint quantity parameter only exists to drive mintClown control and arithmetic, so it collapses into the function node.
Cached balance is a transient local of withdrawAll and carries no independent semantics.
Per-recipient amount is computed only inside withdrawAll's payout loop.
Cached totalSupply local is used solely within reserveClown.
Loop counter exists only to iterate the reserveClown mint loop.
Parameter is immediately written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP by setRevealTimestamp.
Parameter is immediately written into CLOWN_PROVENANCE by setProvenanceHash.
Parameter is only forwarded to _setBaseURI by setBaseURI.
Mint index is derived from totalSupply() inside the mintClown loop only.
